snippet.title: Subnautica 2 | Dev Vlog - Swimming Forward
snippet.description:
For our first Subnautica 2 Dev Vlog since Early Access launch, Design Lead Anthony Gallegos is sharing his heartfelt thanks on behalf of the development team for the overwhelming support so far!

He’s also covering what to expect in our upcoming updates over the coming weeks and months, as we pivot away from rapid hotfixes to focus on our 1.1 update.

Keep Diving!
